G. 5000-M

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ...
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date November 24. 19 34.
Subject (in full) Case against Tsiang Zai Sih (蒋瑞锡) and Nyi Bai Oong (倪伯鸣)
charged with being communists.
Made by D.I. Kuh Foo-hwa Forwarded by [签名]
Regarding the case against Tsiang Zai Sih (蒋瑞锡)
and Nyi Bai Oong (倪伯鸣) who were arrested by the Municipal
Police on the authority of warrants issued at the instance
of the Public Safety Bureau at No.139, Lane 1143, East Yuhang
Road, at 11 p.m. October 24, 1934, on a charge of being
communists, which was concluded on October 31, 1934, when
the accused were ordered to be extradited to the Chinese
Authorities, I forward herewith tabulated statements referring
to these individuals together with a draft of a covering
letter to the French Police relating to this case.
[批：加]
Kuh Foo-hwa
D. I.
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.
File
[签名]

S.2，特别处
报告
日期：1934年11月24日。
事由（全称）：针对蒋瑞锡 (Tsiang Zai Sih) 和倪伯鸣 (Nyi Bai Oong) 被控为共产党员的案件。
呈报人：警探长 Kuh Foo-hwa 转呈人 [签名]
关于蒋瑞锡 (Tsiang Zai Sih) 和倪伯鸣 (Nyi Bai Oong) 一案，二人于1934年10月24日晚11时，依据公共安全局签发的逮捕令，在余杭东路1143弄139号被工部局警务处逮捕，罪名是共产党员。该案已于1934年10月31日结案，当时命令将被告引渡给中国当局。现随函附上涉及上述人员的表格陈述，以及致法国警察有关此案的公函草稿。
[批注：加]
Kuh Foo-hwa
警探长
副总监，
特别处。
存档
[签名]
